videos.title: Investigating History
videos.description: Experts use the latest in forensic techniques to test various theories relating to the assassination of President John F. Kennedy.

videos.title: The Kennedy Assassination: 24 Hours After
videos.description: New information about the 24-hour period after President John F. Kennedy's assassination in 1963 includes the transfer of power to Vice President Lyndon B. Johnson.

videos.title: JFK Assassination: The Definitive Guide
videos.description: Experts discuss the leading theories about the JFK assassination and the supporting evidence.

videos.title: Lee Harvey Oswald: 48 Hours to Live
videos.description: Tracing Oswald's actions in the minutes, hours and days following the events in Dallas, Texas.

videos.title: JFK Declassified: Tracking Oswald
videos.description: Former CIA agent Bob Baer launches a global investigation into the assassination of President John F. Kennedy and tracks the movements of Lee Harvey Oswald; Baer discovers a CIA document revealing that Oswald met with Soviet officials in Mexico City.

videos.title: JFK Declassified: Tracking Oswald
videos.description: Bob Baer explores the connections between Lee Harvey Oswald and the Russian government; the team tracks down a former KGB officer whose stunning testimony jolts the investigation.

videos.title: JFK Declassified: Tracking Oswald
videos.description: Bob and his team focus their efforts on Louisiana, where Lee Harvey Oswald lived in the months prior to the murder of President Kennedy; the team uncovers a period of time during which no one can account for Oswald's whereabouts or activities.

videos.title: JFK Declassified: Tracking Oswald
videos.description: Newly declassified government files reveal that Lee Harvey Oswald may have been involved with an underground operation in the swamps of Louisiana, training with mercenaries and violent extremists only months before the assassination.

videos.title: JFK Declassified: Tracking Oswald
videos.description: CIA veteran Bob Baer's investigation leads him back to the scene of the crime in Dallas; examining Lee Harvey Oswald's every move in Dallas, Bob seeks to prove he had help in his mission.

videos.title: JFK Declassified: Tracking Oswald
videos.description: Bob retraces Lee Harvey Oswald's every step in Dallas, attempting to reconstruct his planned escape after the assassination; Bob makes an unbelievable discovery; the team ventures into international waters to pressure test their findings.

videos.title: JFK Declassified: The New Files
videos.description: Examining the most shocking documents the federal government released related to the assassination of President John F. Kennedy on October 26, 2017.

videos.title: Biz Kids
videos.description: Do the right thing! You'll learn with the Biz Kid$ as they examine several aspects of ethics in business. You'll also see the downside of not following ethical business practices. In this episode you will discover what it means for management to lead by example, and how employees must take responsibility for their behavior. Meet a former computer hacker who turned his life around.
